dct_description_sm: This is a data schema created using Agri-food Data Canada's Semantic Engine . Data schemas describe data that are collected on an ongoing basis from research centres, and provide add-on documentation that enhances the value of raw data. This data schema is used to record and manage ultrasound pregnancy check information by herd veterinarian for beef cattle. It includes details of reproductive health such as ultrasound date, diagnosis (such as pregnancy status or other reproductive conditions), fetus gender, and unique identifiers for the animal. Data described in this schema is sample data, to request access to the related data, please visit the Ontario Beef Research Centre Data Portal.
